question: Can I work while studying on a student visa?
answer:
Yes, student visa holders and their family members can work while studying in Australia. However, there are conditions:

* When the course is in session, students can work up to 48 hours a fortnight (Source: [500_when_have.pdf, p.3]).
* If the student is studying a master's degree by research or doctoral degree, and their family members, they can work more than 48 hours a fortnight (Source: [500_when_have.pdf, p.3]).
* When the course is not in session, student visa holders can work unlimited hours, but their family members still have limited work rights (Source: [500_when_have.pdf, p.3]).
